summary.text: John Boyle is the Republican candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Ky Holland.
He served as Alaska Commissioner of Natural Resources from January 2023 to October 2025.

paragraphs.text: John Boyle earned a bachelor's degree and a law degree from Brigham Young University and has worked in the oil and gas industry.
Gov. Mike Dunleavy appointed Boyle commissioner of the Alaska Department of Natural Resources, and he assumed office on January 6, 2023.
He resigned on October 24, 2025, and John Crowther succeeded him.
Boyle advanced from the August 18, 2026 primary with 41.7 percent of the vote.
